questions.stem: Simple interest on ₹5,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years is:
Pointing to a photograph, Ravi says, “She is the daughter of my mother’s only son.” How is the girl related to Ravi?
questions.explain: Ravi’s mother’s only son is Ravi himself, so the girl is his daughter.

questions.stem: Five friends sit in a row facing north. A is left of B, C is right of B, D is left of A, and E is at the extreme right. Who sits in the middle?
questions.explain: Order left to right is D, A, B, C, E, so B is in the middle.

questions.stem: Choose the word that is most nearly opposite in meaning to “scarce”.
questions.explain: Scarce means in short supply; abundant is the opposite.

questions.stem: Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is the share of deposits that scheduled banks must keep as cash with:
questions.explain: CRR is maintained as a cash balance with the RBI.

questions.stem: NEFT is a payment system used mainly for:
choices: Electronic transfer of funds between bank accounts
questions.explain: National Electronic Funds Transfer moves money between bank accounts in batches.

questions.stem: A scheduled bank in India is one that is:
choices: Included in the Second Schedule to the RBI Act, 1934
Owned only by the central government
questions.explain: Scheduled status comes from inclusion in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act.

questions.stem: An article is bought for ₹250 and sold at a 20% profit. The selling price is:
The idiom “once in a blue moon” means:
questions.explain: It means something that happens only rarely.
